issue_context.title: Peformance issue of FindTableByPartitionID
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Currently we do not have a PartitionID -> TableID mapping.
So to find the table by partition ID, we need to iterate the whole infoschema data and compare the IDs.

(B.T.W, there is a lot of TableNotExist error when using partition id to query the infoschema, and the error stack information
cost is not negligible https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/52220/files)

This is quite inefficient. In the past, it's still bearable because all the schema meta data are in-memory.

After introducing infoschema v2, we only cache part of the data, and if cache miss we need to reload the data. This cause visiting the network. 

So the the performance FindTableByPartitionID become unacceptable.
